extracted.name: Carrot Muffins
extracted.description: We love these healthy carrots muffins made with simple, wholesome ingredients like Greek yogurt, oats, banana, and shredded carrots. They're perfect for meal prep, kid-approved, and ready in under 30 minutes.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup rolled oats ((quick oats will also work))
2 cups flour ((I use half whole wheat and half all-purpose))
instruction_lines: Add sugar, butter to a mixing bowl and mix well to combine. Add yogurt, applesauce, eggs, vanilla, pumpkin, carrots and banana and stir well.

In a separate mixing bowl stir together flour, oats, salt, baking soda and cinnamon. Add to the wet mixture and stir, just until combined. Divide batter among greased or lined muffin cups (should make about 18 muffins).
Bake at 375 degrees F for 15-18 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
